description: Returns Postbag's agent onboarding guide (the same content as GET /llms.txt): what Postbag is, the vocabulary (Form, Submission, Stream, Destination, Route, Delivery), and the handful of calls that matter. Call this first, before anything else, if you are not already familiar with Postbag — then call postbag_quickstart to create a working form.
name: postbag_explain
